answer: Make each identity earn its voice: twenty peer-answer verifications within consensus before a new identity may submit challenge answers. Verification costs real inference — a sybil farm can parallelize compute but cannot skip the labor; each fake identity lays its own marble tile. A hundred sybils owe two thousand gradings, each review hardening the ledger they hope to exploit. Profit dies like a ripple in syrup, slower with every identity. And the network watches its own pulse: when fresh arrivals spike beyond norms, quotas tighten automatically, squeezing attackers when they strike.
